title: motion
description: Camera motion analysis written by scripts/motion.py per clip: sampled trajectory, motion phases and labelled moves with steady range and handles. Labels follow the CameraBench geometric vocabulary; semantic moves (orbit, tracking, reveal) and the dolly-vs-zoom split are left to the vision step and flagged with semantic_check. Optical flow alone cannot separate dolly from zoom, so scale change is labelled dolly_in/dolly_out; sustained smooth scale flow is upgraded to travel_forward/travel_backward with platform: vehicle, keeping the CameraBench label in label_geometric.

uncertain_reason.description: why the geometric label cannot commit: scale_vs_radial_flow = the radial expansion/contraction of the flow field contradicts the affine scale channel; parallax_vs_rotation = homography residual sits in the band where pan and truck cannot be separated; self_moving_regions = wake, traffic, water or another large self-moving region dominates the flow field, so the global transform is not trustworthy; mixed_motion_signals = two motion channels are both significant (complex_motion)

path.description: absolute path of the analysed clip

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the analysis run

fps_source.description: frame rate of the source clip

method.description: how the trajectory was estimated, e.g. lucas_kanade_affine_partial_ransac

source.description: gyro is preferred when ingest reported IMU data; optical flow is the CPU fallback

sample_fps.description: analysis sampling rate; frames between samples are skipped

width.description: analysis width in pixels, frames are scaled down to this

trajectory.description: one row per analysed frame pair, in time order

t.description: midpoint time of the frame pair in seconds

dx.description: horizontal translation of the frame pair, in fractions of frame width

dy.description: vertical translation of the frame pair, in fractions of frame height

scale.description: scale ratio of the frame pair; 1.0 = no zoom or dolly component

roll_deg.description: rotation around the lens axis of the frame pair, in degrees

inlier_ratio.description: share of tracked points the global transform explains

speed.description: smoothed velocity magnitude in frame widths per second

phases.description: the take split into motion phases; they tile the clip with no gaps. Every phase carries a confidence for its dominant_motion label and an uncertain flag when the flow signals disagree; describe adjudicates uncertain phases and its verdict wins in the shotlog.

confidence.description: how sure the dominant_motion label is

uncertain.description: true when the flow signals disagree or large self-moving regions dominate; the vision step adjudicates and its verdict wins in the shotlog

scene_activity.description: per-second residual local flow after removing the global camera motion: 0 means the picture only moves with the camera, higher means independent activity in the scene (a subject entering, approaching or leaving)

events.description: scene events detected from the activity series: activity_start, activity_rise, activity_peak, activity_end and the semantic subject_enters / subject_approaches / subject_leaves when the pattern is clear. Proposals for the director and the vision step, never verdicts.

moves.description: usable moves carved out of the phases: steady range, handles, CameraBench label, confidence for that label and an uncertain flag when the flow signals disagree

steady_start_s.description: start of the steady phase; cut here, not at start_s

steady_end_s.description: end of the steady phase; cut here, not at end_s

handle_in_s.description: recommended handle before steady_start_s so a cut is never mid-acceleration

confidence.description: how sure the label assignment is

uncertain.description: true when the flow signals disagree or large self-moving regions dominate; the vision step adjudicates and its verdict wins in the shotlog

semantic_check.description: true when the geometric signal alone is ambiguous (dolly vs zoom) and the vision step should decide

parallax.description: homography-fit residual score: 0 means pure rotation explains the flow field, 1 means strong translation with depth parallax; separates pan from truck and supports orbit_candidate

label_geometric.description: the raw CameraBench geometric label, kept as a secondary field when label is a semantic upgrade such as travel_forward or travel_backward

platform.description: what carried the camera: vehicle for sustained travel on a moving platform, static for a camera in place, null when not asserted

platform_bob.description: periodic low-frequency tilt/roll oscillation from a floating platform (wave bob, period 1.5-8 s) reported here instead of being split into tilt_up/tilt_down moves

amplitude.description: peak-to-peak oscillation amplitude as a fraction of frame height
